sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages Grey and Transformation Magic, read through search summaries only (host unreachable): she takes the appearance of other people or objects and, unlike other users, can transform other things (rocks, enemy spells).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by search (the official TV Tokyo site lists her magic as 変身, manganoshirabe says the transformation is really Transmutation, the 必殺技辞典 lists マジックコンバート).
sources.repo_wiki: The fandom spell page Ultra Giant Bull (Compound Magic) cached in the repo: the Transmutation user turns a large structure into the material of the Recombination house.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells_bulls.md.

spells.name: Transmutation: Iron Spikes
spells.note: Mode 0 of the Transmutation book, so it cannot be hidden; no source names it for Grey.

spells.name: Transformation Magic: Borrowed Form
spells.note: NEW page: she takes another shape. The mod cannot change a player's skin, so the effect is a vanishing act (invisibility and speed, hunters lose her).

spells.name: Transmutation Magic: Magic Convert
spells.note: Converts one thing into another (enemy spells included, as the wiki says of her magic). The 必殺技辞典 entry is attached to her name but is disputed.

spells.name: Transmutation: Sand Shower
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): air turned to sand.

spells.name: Transmutation: Copper Bolts
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): transmuted copper bolts.

spells.name: Transmutation: Flowering
spells.note: Grey and Gauche turned the tendrils into flowers in the Spade raid (docs/arc/morris_libardirt.md); existing page.

spells.name: Transmutation: Rubber Spring
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): the ground turned to rubber.

spells.name: Transmutation: Lead Weights
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): a foe turned heavy as lead.

spells.name: Transmutation: Quagmire
spells.note: Ground turned to sand (existing page; her magic converts the ground and rocks, as the wiki says).

spells.name: Transmutation: Brass Whips
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): a band of air turned to brass.

spells.name: Transmutation: Alchemic Blades
spells.note: Blades of iron and brass (existing page).

spells.name: Transmutation: Transmuted Sentinel
spells.note: A golem of iron and stone (existing page; her magic turns rocks into other things, as the wiki says).

spells.name: Transmutation: Salt Flats
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): ground turned to salt.

spells.name: Alchemist's Armour
spells.note: The Gilded Plate (existing page; a short buff, not worn armour).

spells.name: Transformation: Living Statue
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): she can transform other things such as rocks (the wiki); here the foes are turned to stone for a moment. Opens only after Magic Convert.

planned.name: Transformation of rocks and other objects
planned.note: Described only in general terms; no spell name.

planned.name: Ultra Giant Bull (Compound Magic: converts a structure into the house's material)
planned.note: The page lives in the Recombination book and is in Henry's set.

notes: The sources for Grey are the thinnest of the squad: her magic is listed as Transformation although the series reveals it to be Transmutation, and no spell names were found. Not in her grimoire (kept in the basic Transmutation book): Grand Transmutation and Iron Rain. Pages-15 added twelve pages to her set (six existing ones that fit a magic that converts ground, rocks and flowers, and six new shared pages) so her grimoire shows 15.
